description: Use when you need to know whether an address is a contract on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon or Optimism: is_contract, bytecode size, sha256 of the bytecode. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /evm/code, $0.002 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. Contract check with bytecode size and hash only; for the coin balance use evm_native_balance, for the transaction count use evm_nonce. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

address.description: Address to test for contract code (0x + 40 hex); a plain account returns is_contract=false
